title: UserProvisioningDeleteResponseDataType
description: Response DataType for a UserProvisioning delete request. Captures outcome code, human-readable description and optional error message.
x-ecohub-license: © 2025 EcoHub AG. Usage restricted. Prior written authorization required. Swiss law applies. Jurisdiction: Zurich.

code.description: Outcome code: OK, USER_NOT_FOUND, or ERROR.

description.description:
Human readable explanation of the code. Examples:
- OK: The information about deleting the user on EcoHub has been registered.
- USER_NOT_FOUND: The user with the specified IDP_UserID does not exist at the service provider.
- ERROR: An internal error occurred; see errorMessage for stack trace.

errorMessage.description: Optional error details or stack trace when code is ERROR.
